title: Specified scalar and compactification comparisons for the affine counit
statement: On ordinary etale constant-ring derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], fix a coefficient map A to B, an annihilator N, and the finite Tate line [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Define reductionEtaleTateMap by the unique sheaf map taking each A Tate generator a tensor z to the B generator phi(a) tensor z. Define reductionEtaleTateExtensionMap as its derived scalar/restriction adjunct through the exact single-complex comparison, and reductionEtaleTateIso as this map with its proved invertibility when N is invertible. Define reductionEtaleShiftedLineIso using the scalar shift comparison, reductionEtaleP1ScalarIso using the tensorator and pullback comparison, and reductionEtaleLineScalarIso by preceding that with the inverse scalar/pullback comparison for the standard open chart. Define reductionEtaleAffineScalarIso by ordered coordinate recursion, with identity at zero. Define reductionEtaleAffineLeftIso from the ordered left tower [def-amb-affine-trace-construction] to a specified compactification by the inverse identity normalization at zero, then the published pairwise and binary composition comparisons at each successor [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. These are the existing constructed definitions in ReductionExceptional; no assertion of the affine scalar counit theorem is included.

lean.statement:
def reductionEtaleLineScalarIso {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (S : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    (Etale.scalarExtension φ (AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} S)).obj
        ((Etale.affineTraceLineRight A N hA S).obj K) ≅
      (Etale.affineTraceLineRight B N hB S).obj ((Etale.scalarExtension φ S).obj K)
